text:
ITEM 1 | Folded or rolled flatbread-style wrap, golden-tan with browned blisters, cut into two triangular halves, topped with melted pale yellow cheese and scattered orange-red sauce spots, sitting on the left-center of the plate; each half roughly 8 cm long and 5 cm wide, about 1.5 cm thick | 150
ITEM 2 | Shredded light-brown cooked meat with pale fibrous strands and slight moisture, loosely piled in a mound about 9 cm across and 1.5 cm tall at the lower-left of the plate, with thin strips of orange carrot-like shreds on top | 120
ITEM 3 | Sliced green bell pepper strips, bright green with slight sheen, mixed with red bell pepper strips, glossy and firm, arranged in a loose fan about 9 cm long on the right side of the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Small cubes of pale off-white cooked meat or tofu-like pieces, matte surface with slight browning at edges, scattered in a cluster about 5 cm across between the shredded meat and the pepper strips, each cube about 1.5 cm | 25
ITEM 5 | Red tomato-based sauce, bright orange-red, glossy, visible as spots and smears on top of the cheese and flatbread, thin layer about 0.2 cm thick | 10
